title: Canonical Account Reference
description: Compact advertiser-account reference for canonical 3.2 tools. Uses either the seller/storefront account_id, which is the account's identity, or the buyer-declared natural key without BrandRef inline overrides. The natural key is brand + operator; its optional brand.countries, operator_unit.id, currency, timezone, and sandbox fields are account attributes that act as lookup filters, matched as in account-ref.json. A natural key resolves only when exactly one of the caller's accounts matches; otherwise the seller returns ACCOUNT_AMBIGUOUS. brand.countries does not target delivery; operator_unit.name is display metadata and never filters.

operator_unit.description: Optional operator-owned business unit, agency seat, or platform account. An account attribute: id acts as a lookup filter; name is display metadata and never filters.

currency.description: ISO 4217 transaction currency when the advertiser object is currency-bound. An account attribute that acts as a lookup filter; all media buys on the account use it. Omit for per-media-buy currency selection.

timezone.description: Account timezone. An account attribute that acts as a lookup filter, sent only for buyer-selected account_fixed accounts.
